prompt:

response.content:
I cannot find an official, explicit statement from the Raspberry Pi Foundation or Raspberry Pi Ltd declaring a specific, pre-determined end-of-life date for the Raspberry Pi 5. Companies like Raspberry Pi typically do not announce a product's discontinuation date years in advance, as it depends on market demand, component availability, and future product developments.

The official stance, as stated on their website, is a long-term commitment to the product's availability, which is the standard and expected practice for all Raspberry Pi boards.

Here is the official statement regarding product availability:

SOURCE: https://www.raspberrypi.com/products/raspberry-pi-5/ | QUOTE: "We expect to be making Raspberry Pi 5 well into the latter part of the decade; and we will continue to make it for as long as there is demand." | CLAIM: This shows the Raspberry Pi Foundation's commitment to producing the Raspberry Pi 5 for a long time, at least until the late 2020s, contingent on ongoing customer demand.
